riemann-four-sums.alt: Four panels show f(x) = 0.25x squared + 1 on [0, 4], increasing and concave up, with four subintervals of width 1: a left sum of 7.5 (an underestimate), a right sum of 11.5 (an overestimate), a midpoint sum of 9.25 (an underestimate) and a trapezoidal sum of 9.5 (an overestimate). The true area is 28/3, about 9.33.
